title: Runner and tool certification matrix: prove each supported assessment family has install, fixture, output, and report evidence
goal: Make the supported-tool and supported-runner surface enterprise-verifiable by certifying every tracked assessment family against installation readiness, safe fixture/lab proof, normalized output contracts, evidence artifacts, report mapping, and known limitations.
scope: Build a certification matrix after the current tool/runners expansion work. For each software tool group and custom runner, record installed/ready state, required authorization tier, safe fixture or benchmark proof, expected artifact schema, finding/report mapping, false-positive guardrails, and unsupported/hardware blockers. This task does not add new runners; it proves the ones AegisPT claims to support.
generation_reason: Settings/tool readiness currently says whether binaries exist, but enterprise clients need proof that each supported runner actually produces reliable evidence and report output under safe validation conditions.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Certification and evidence matrix only. Do not implement new detection capabilities or run against live external targets in this task.

success_criteria: A machine-readable runner/tool certification matrix lists each tracked tool group and runner with ready state, authorization tier, safe validation fixture, output contract, report mapping, and limitations.
Every claimed supported runner links to at least one deterministic test, fixture/lab proof, or explicit supported-with-gap reason.
Hardware-only blockers such as wireless adapters are separated from software installation readiness.
Report/finding mapping is verified for certified runners so output is not stranded as raw artifacts only.
The matrix feeds or is referenced by Settings/Diagnostics and enterprise release-readiness outputs.

acceptance_criteria: Every supported runner/tool claim is backed by test or fixture evidence, or marked supported-with-gap/blocked honestly.
The certification matrix can be consumed by release-readiness and operator diagnostics.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the only active task.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
